interpreter_substrate_I.boundary: I is what the host must execute; it contains no primitive identifier and no table of implementations. L is the set of primitive definitions and is entirely lineage state. M090 claims ownership of L only; I remains authored and is the next ceiling.

migration.conservation_space: every legacy program of length<=2 over the full legacy alphabet, on four input tuples

not_a_reattempt: M090 does not re-run M089's qualification, does not modify its result, and makes no claim about H35. The probe extension here is authored and is described as such.

predecessor.defect: m089_meta_language.execute dispatched base operations from the module constant L0_OPERATIONS and a host function; language.base_operations was serialized, digested and rolled back but consulted by nothing, so with an empty registry no fault to the serialized state could change behaviour

subtitle: The language the lineage stores is the language the interpreter actually executes
title: Executable Meta-Language State
verdict_rule: positive iff every condition is true; each is computed and each can fail
